rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal ball of snow, including one used in a snowball fight.

example.english: When it snowed, we had a snowball fight on the hillside and didn't want to leave.
example.traditional: 落雪嗰陣，我哋喺山坡度掟雪球，玩到唔捨得走。
example.jyutping: lok6 syut3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 bo1 dou6 deng3 syut3 kau4 waan2 dou3 m4 se2 dak1 zau2

rows.note: Use this for an abstract snowballing effect in which a situation grows rapidly and becomes difficult to control.

example.english: The problem kept growing, creating a snowball effect that eventually became difficult for the whole company to control.
example.traditional: 呢個問題一路擴大，形成雪球效應，最後搞到成間公司都難以收拾。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jat1 lou6 kwok3 daai6 jing4 sing4 syut3 kau4 haau6 jing3 zeoi3 hau6 gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 naan4 ji5 sau1 sap6
